engine: @napi-rs/canvas; offline production Canvas functions, not browser/layout/device validation

source.baseMeaning: Unmodified production code baseline, not the candidate revision under test

historicalStructuralFix.status: Structural browser retest passed; art not approved; physical device not validated

previousCandidate.status: Browser structural checks passed; art failed

shoreVariation.note: This readable-band/path-cache revision needs new browser acceptance; prior B results do not transfer.

profiling.timingScope: Synchronous elapsed call time, including instrumentation overhead. No GPU/raster completion, asynchronous paint, compositor, or input-to-present measurement. DOM timings include only work performed synchronously in the labelled call. viewportReadSyncMs covers controller reads on resize; renderer dimension reads remain in remainingFrameSyncMs. DOM write timings do not imply all subsequent layout work has completed.
profiling.firstFrameMeaning: Forced ground rebuild for each case, not a fresh process/JIT/image-decode cache. Warm samples retain the same scene and ground cache.
profiling.coldBuildMsMeaning: Legacy terrain buildGround timer only; coldFrameMs covers the complete synchronous G.frame call. firstFrame and warmSamples split build submission, ground drawImage call and remaining G.frame time.

uiLayout.reason: Native Canvas has no browser DOM, controls, layout, compositor or device validation.

displayCacheNote: Original renderer writes chimney anchor, previous screen x and sprite-facing caches. Full scene state therefore changes; only these three audited presentation fields are excluded from gameplay comparison.
